description: Submit one catalog job within the account owner's saved spending policy. Reuse idempotency_key on every retry. This spends prepaid credits; it never signs x402 or funds the account.

capability_id.description: Buyer service_id returned by discovery, not an implementation_capability_id. Select a supported service before submitting.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller-chosen identifier for one purchase. Preserve the exact key and request on retries; recover uncertain submissions with list_account_jobs using this key.

max_total_price.description: Caller-approved total price ceiling in USD as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Not a quote, funding instruction or policy authorization; the saved spending policy must also permit this job.

request.description: User inputs matching the selected service request_schema. Consult its required fields and example; ask for missing data, units, rules or tolerances rather than inventing them.

name: run_account_job

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core response object; fields depend on the action and saved job version. Balance is not spending-policy readiness.

title: Run a job using prepaid RQM credits
